turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I'm Hugh Glass of...

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: We don't serve niggers.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
Of the Rocky Mountain Fur Company
           on my way to Fort Union.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
I don't care if you was with Lewis
           and Clark headed for the new world.
           We don't serve niggers.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
All I need is a horse and enough
           supplies to...

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
Ice musta froze up his ears, `cause
           he ain't listenin' to you, Cees.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
...to get me to Fort Union. I can
           sign a draft made good by Captain
           Henry.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
What the fuck happened to your
           face, boy? You try to slice all
           the black off?
           81.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
Maybe we oughta help him do it
           right.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: Best get on your way, boy.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
I'm Hugh Glass of the Rocky
           Mountain Fur Company, and all I
           need is...

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
(to the trappers)
           Do you believe this shit?

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: Hell, I warned ya.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: All I need...

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
...is a horse and enough supplies
           to get me to Fort Union.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
And this shooter here. All made
           good by Captain Henry and The Rocky
           Mountain Fur Company.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Shoot him, goddammit!
           82.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: I can't get a clear look.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Shoot `em both!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Get after the son of a bitch!

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: It's cold as hell, Cees.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote:
And he did say to put it all on the
           Rocky Mountain tab.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Jesus Christ.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
You took everything I had... left
           me to die.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Why?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: I was scared of dyin'.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote:
But every day since, I've wished I
           had.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
There wasn't no `Ree that night,
           was there?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: No.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote: Hugh. Wait.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Where's Fitzgerald and my rifle?

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
Deserted two days ago. Along with
           about five hundred dollars of
           company money.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
Let's get some coffee to warm you
           up.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote: I wanna hear what happened.

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: Wait. Please!
